description: This file is a BitBake recipe fragment for the 'quilt' package, specifying how to fetch, configure, build, test, and install the quilt patch management tool within a Yocto-based build system. It contains metadata, source URLs, patches, dependencies, and build instructions.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Prepares configuration files by modifying shebang lines in '*.in' files to avoid using '-w' flags.

methods.name: do_configure:class-native
methods.description: Runs the configuration step natively inside the build environment.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the compiled quilt tool into the destination directory, cleans up unneeded directories.

methods.name: do_install:append:class-native
methods.description: Creates a dummy quiltrc configuration file in the system configuration directory.

methods.name: do_compile_ptest
methods.description: Compiles testing components, building patch wrapper and dependencies.

methods.name: do_install_ptest
methods.description: Installs testing components by extracting tarballs and copying test files.
